title: Giant flown to a base in Qatar

tellings.quote: and then they they transferred it to Qatar, a base in Qatar.

plain: Tim Alberino, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast who says US troops captured a 12 foot giant in Afghanistan, passes on what he was told about what happened next. According to Alberino, in 2005 the giant was moved to a military base in Qatar, a small country in the Persian Gulf. If true, it would mean the military took custody of a giant and kept it hidden.
